reason: My Facebook page and Google Maps already bring people to call or WhatsApp me, and I've done fine for years without a website. At 65 I'm not paying €600 plus another monthly fee for something I'd hardly touch.
objection: Another monthly fee for a site I'll rarely change, and I don't believe tourists will find me through it instead of the booking platform.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another driver or boat operator nearby that the site actually brought direct bookings and cut what they pay the booking platform in commission within one season.
